The client protocol ​

Everything a client (the widget, a web view, a native app) needs. The widget in packages/widget implements all of it; a native client implements the same calls.

Authentication ​

  • Every /api/* call except /api/health and /api/auth/exchange carries Authorization: Bearer &lt;token> when login is on. The token is either an agent token from POST /api/auth/exchange (preferred — docs/SDK-AUTH.md) or your upstream token, verified strictly. 401 login_required / token_expired, 503 auth_unavailable.
  • Optional embed gating: X-Agent-Key: <gateway key>.

Endpoints ​

Method & pathPurpose
POST /api/sessionCreate a chat → {session_id, nudge, brand}. Store the id (localStorage) to resume.
POST /api/chatOne turn, JSON: {session_id, message, display?} → AgentReply
POST /api/chat/streamThe same turn as Server-Sent Events (below)
POST /api/chat/voiceRaw audio in (Content-Type: audio/*, X-Agent-Session), SSE out starting with transcript
POST /api/transcribeTranscription only
GET /api/session/:id/historyResume: {entries:[{role,text,ui}], completion, preview, completed, usage, media, nudge}. 410 ⇒ start fresh.
GET /api/session/:id/eventsLong-lived SSE for server-initiated events (ready, nudge, heartbeats)
GET /api/session/:id/usageToken usage and cap standings (percentages)
GET /api/my/sessionsThe caller's chats (metadata + a short preview)
DELETE /api/session/:idDelete a chat (owner)
POST / GET / PATCH / DELETE /api/mediaUpload one file (raw body, X-Agent-Session, X-Agent-Filename), list, arrange ({order, labels, cover}), remove (?key=)
GET /api/healthReadiness + configuration summary (no secrets)
GET /widget.jsThe embeddable client

Stream events (/api/chat/stream) ​

event: transcript  data: {text, language, confidence, duration_s}   (voice only, first)
event: delta       data: {text}                                      prose, word by word; ui fences never stream
event: tool        data: {name}                                      a tool started (show a status line)
event: preview     data: PreviewState                                the draft: slots, missing, state, defaults, steps…
event: done        data: {reply, ui, tool_trace, domain, kind?, completion?, usage}
event: error       data: {error, error_id?, degraded?}

kind names the runtime step that answered a turn without a model call. completion ends the chat: render the end-state card (label, entity_url only when present), freeze the composer, keep uploads welcome.

ui blocks ​

A reply's ui is an array of blocks (types in @marg-adk/types). Tapping an option sends its value as the user's next message; a form submit sends "Label [key]: value; …" plus a readable display. Block families:

  • chips (single pick; ghost, sel, disabled, limit), multichips (min, max, submit, own {max}, page, skip), list (rows with title/subtitle/value).
  • card (title, fields [{label, value, source}], actions, sections — the review's per-section edit chips). The runtime's summary card carries confirm: true.
  • form (rows [{key, label, kind: pick|multi|text|num|area, options, value, required, hint, source, unit, error, say}], submit, echo, skip). Required rows gate the submit; an option's fills sets other rows.
  • toggles (options [{label, value, on}], hint, wire {prefix, none}).
  • link (label, url — http/https or your app's scheme only).
  • Runtime-only: table, progress, media, bars.
  • Every block may carry step: "<key>" — which runtime step drew it (evals and clients key on it).

Resume, nudges, completion ​

  • Store the session id; on load call /history and replay entries; the last assistant entry carries the open ask's block again, so the user can answer after a refresh.
  • Open /events to receive nudges live; they are also persisted into the transcript.
  • A finished chat answers 409 to a new turn; "start another" = a new session.

Media ​

Upload immediately (one request per file, raw bytes); the gateway holds keys on the session, attaches them the instant the write returns an id, and keeps accepting uploads after completion. GET /api/media → {file_base, items:[{key, kind, url?, filename, label?, cover, attached}], attached_to}; an image loads from file_base + "/" + key when no url is given.

Voice ​

Record a note, POST the bytes; the stream opens with transcript, then the normal events. The note IS the message (no edit step); STT runs server-side so keys never reach the client.

Errors ​

{error, code?, error_id?}. Codes: login_required, token_expired, auth_unavailable, rate_limit (with Retry-After), usage_cap (scope, percent, resets_in_s), completed. Unknown-session text is exact ("Unknown session — call /api/session first.") — clients key their recovery on it.

Source: docs/CLIENT-PROTOCOL.md — edit it there; the site mirrors the repository.
